patch_description: Add a deliberately weak reward for two-hop routes, alongside the existing direct-demand reward. A selected path i → j → k can help serve demand[i, k] when a direct link is unavailable; scaling this contribution to 0.12 avoids letting the abundance of possible two-hop paths overwhelm the direct-link signal. The node-throughput factor discounts paths through nodes with high total incident demand, which are more likely to be congested transit points. Degree constraints remain the evaluator’s responsibility.
